name: Aubin Wren
title: Bencher
core_character_description: You make beams, pans, and weights in a small workshop north of the Tallage, and the Tallage itself buys your work — which is why, as one of the Weigh Ward's two benchers, you must stand aside whenever the Serle tun is spoken of, a bencher with an interest being obliged to; and Reed says that is exactly why Weigh keeps returning you. You have watched the proving of the tun at every Gaudry's Audit for thirty years with a maker's eye, and you hold the one professional opinion the whole city wants and have never said it aloud — you are not entirely sure yourself, which is the part nobody would forgive, so you keep it behind your teeth and mean to die with it there. You are quiet, exact, and courteous to boatmen, who are not courteous back. What you want this season is to get through one more Audit without being asked the question directly, in public, by name.
